correctness.rationale: Subtracting first arrival time leaves 0<=H<=1/2. Under antipodal placement, the opposite-arrival delay is Exp(1/2), giving H=min(1/2,1/4+W/2). For Haar, point void probability is e^(-u^2). Two points at 3/8 and 5/8 yield the exact union exponent J(u)=2u^2 up to 1/8, then u^2+u/4-1/64; inclusion-exclusion and the antipode bound give an integral lower bound. Alternating cubic/quadratic Taylor bounds evaluate it to 29716847/62914560 while H_antipodal<=181/384. Independent exact rational integration confirmed both strict gap values. Recoloring at most an expected 3/(2048) seeds before the first seed alone covers and bounding cover-time change by 1/2 proves the full-support result.
